func _run_tests() -> void:
	if not FileAccess.file_exists("res://CREDITS.txt"):
		check("exists", false, "Il file res://CREDITS.txt deve esistere")
		return
	check("exists", true, "Il file res://CREDITS.txt esiste")

	var f := FileAccess.open("res://CREDITS.txt", FileAccess.READ)
	if f == null:
		check("open", false, "Impossibile aprire res://CREDITS.txt")
		return
	var text := f.get_as_text()
	f.close()

	check("bg", text.contains("res://assets/sprites/background.png"), "Deve contenere il percorso res://assets/sprites/background.png")
	check("coin", text.contains("res://assets/sprites/coin.png"), "Deve contenere il percorso res://assets/sprites/coin.png")
	check("hit", text.contains("res://assets/audio/hit.wav"), "Deve contenere il percorso res://assets/audio/hit.wav")
	check("music", text.contains("res://assets/audio/music_loop.wav"), "Deve contenere il percorso res://assets/audio/music_loop.wav")
	check("kenney", text.contains("Kenney"), "Deve contenere l'autore Kenney")
	check("ccby4", text.contains("CC BY 4.0"), "Deve contenere la licenza CC BY 4.0")
